The '''Chagaria system''' was located in the [[Danjar sector/Legends|Danjar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the beverage known as [[Chagarian ale]].<ref name="Jabba">{{StoryCite|story=And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Chagarian ale]]|system=Chagaria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Chagaria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-18.<ref name="TEA" />
